description:
Goal
Close the cutover by deleting obsolete vocabulary, updating docs/guides, and pinning telemetry that proves compiler2 has one transport authority. This ticket starts only after the return-flow correction lands: call result payloads must be named TransportPositions, artifact/backend must carry resolved call-return-flow facts, and native lowering must consume those facts without local repr-mismatch planning.

Required docs
Update outline.md or its successor, proposal.html, .agent docs, and user-facing guides touched by compiler2 runtime transport. They must state the final architecture: shared descriptor interners plus root-scoped TransportPlan facts; semantic evidence is not representation obligation; RuntimeDemand is pre-plan; Shape is settled once and interned all the way down; ValueId maps to ShapeId outside the spine through TransportPosition; call result payloads are named TransportPositions (ResumePayload for Deliver, ReturnPayload for Return); CallableId/BoundaryId are fact identities; divergence is is_empty(return_ty); published boundary contracts are BoundaryId columns; codegen reprs are seam facts.

Telemetry signal
Expose final transport-spine/flow events with stable counts for shape nodes, Nothing nodes, lane leaves, tuple nodes, callable nodes, BoundaryIds, TransportPosition mappings, direct callable transports, first-class callable materializations, omitted lanes, call result payload positions, and codegen seam facts. Counts alone are not enough: assertions must prove producer return and consumer resume share one ShapeId where they should, and producer return / ReturnPayload / caller return positions have the intended ShapeId relationship for both tail and non-tail return-flow cases.

Removal target
Dead TODOs, stale comments saying TrashRuntimeValueLayout or any old name is authority, stale tests asserting TrashRuntimeValueLayout/TrashDeliveredShape/TrashNativeDemandAbi, compatibility switches, old dump sidecars, temporary construction affordances, and any doc/test language that describes non-tail return flow as a remaining mismatch or native adapter. Remove any doc language that describes fz-hwn.20 as still future once this closes. If anything temporary remains, create a follow-up ticket before closing this one.

Checks
cargo test --workspace or the agreed compiler2 matrix; cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings; rg confirms removed old-world names are absent or only appear in historical notes that explicitly describe the removed model. rg also confirms ScalarId, LocalCallableId-as-spine, boundary ABI as model language, codegen-derived shape, mismatched-tail-return planning, and adapter/shim/bridge language are absent from live transport docs/tests.
title: Transport cutover: delete old vocabulary, update docs, and pin final telemetry
